## Unlock scan: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` · objectui now installs next.2 · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T11:59Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Both conditions are met.**
  - objectui#12626 closed at 2026-10-16T11:23Z through PR #12648 (`f62b6ff4e1`). objectui `main`'s `pnpm-lock.yaml` now resolves `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.2`.
  - `npm view @objectstack/spec@next` is `18.0.0-next.2`, built from objectstack `e5136ff10f`. `c5dd7fce30` is its ancestor.
- **The work is still there.** `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx:666`–`:669` still widens to keep the `'jsx'` arm compiling.
- **The grade stands:** p2 + `target:v18`.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (`priority:p2`, `target:v18`; half 2 of objectui#12464, unlocked by triage at `6215013185`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12486-drop-jsx-arm`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12486`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the card's five items.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`: the `kind === 'jsx'` arm, the widened `schema.kind` read (back to the authoring type), and the `getJsxManifest` comment;
- `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts`: the comments that name `jsx` as live (`:1298-1355`) only;
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ResourceEditPage.pageRequiresStamp-11357.test.tsx`: the server double, following the resolved spec's `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS`;
- a pin that a `kind: 'jsx'` node is no longer compiled as html; tests beside;
- one `.changeset/12486-*.md` (`@object-ui/components`, minor, per the card).

Outside the surface: the sample's `sdui-jsx-preview.*` file names (the card excludes them), and any other change to `layout.zod.ts`. A route outside it stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier, not the floor: what the renderer does with a stray `jsx` node is a judgment call; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the 5 planned paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: narrowing. `@object-ui/components`' page renderer stops compiling a raw `kind: 'jsx'` node as html. A served page cannot carry `jsx` any more (`next.2`'s `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS` is `['html']`, and spec 18's rehydration turns a stored `jsx` page into `html`), but a host handing a raw node loses it. So the card owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before ready, judged from the content.
Responsibility: n/a — not a defect card
Thread-read: 6215013185
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `a98a23c787`.
- objectui#12626 (the `next.2` move) landed; triage `6215013185` confirms `c5dd7fce30` is an ancestor of `next.2`'s build `e5136ff10f`.
- objectui#12654 (this seat, cloud, in flight) may touch `packages/types/src/**` where the retired `visibleOn` / `visibility` are declared; this card edits only comments in `layout.zod.ts`. Ordinary concurrency: the later lander merges `main`.
- No open PR or in-flight claim names `renderers/layout/page.tsx` or `ResourceEditPage.pageRequiresStamp-11357.test.tsx`.
